provenance.asset_description: A square graphic styled like a magazine cover, an illustration of Vernai-Elect Giovana, a red mantis assassin unmasked and in red leather leather armor stands front and center with the words Venture Gossip in big letters behind her. To the right of the graphic is an orange circle with the picture of a skeletal lich wearing a crown, under the picture is the words, liches, should we be worried? Other headlines are in small print to the left of Vernai-Elect Giovana.
